focus_areas: Skeletal integrity of the Triceratops (no fused or missing bones).
Correct morphological features of the frill and horns (solid vs fenestrated).
Background coherence (avoiding melting artifacts in secondary subjects).
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus heavily on the anatomical correctness of the skeletal mount. AI often struggles with the complex overlapping geometry of ribcages and limb joints in skeletons. Verify that the 'solid frill' does not have unintended holes or warping. Ignore the absence of skin/scales as this is a skeleton, but flag any bone textures that look like melted plastic or skin. Pay special attention to the background elements for signs of AI degradation (smearing/fusion).
image_description: A museum exhibit featuring a Triceratops skeleton in the foreground, characterized by its massive skull, three horns, and large bony frill. In the background, other dinosaur skeletons (including a Hadrosaur) are visible within a gallery setting with windows and lighting fixtures.
